argv: Why did my task cancellation return 409?

parsed.answer: A 409 response on task cancellation means the task is already buffered on a robot that is currently offline, so Fleet Control cannot recall it [sample_corpus/api-reference.md:Fleet Control API Reference > Tasks > DELETE /tasks/{task_id}]. The error code returned is `robot_unreachable` [sample_corpus/faq.md:Frequently Asked Questions > API and Integration > My task cancellation returned 409. What now?]. To resolve it, wait for the `robot.link_restored` event and then retry the cancellation. If the task completes in the meantime, you will get a `404` instead, which is the expected outcome [sample_corpus/faq.md:Frequently Asked Questions > API and Integration > My task cancellation returned 409. What now?].
